pick.headline: Pinochet survives an ambush on his motorcade
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of September 8, 1986, listed under Chile the attack on Pinochet: an official report, Pinochet's own description, US-made weapons, a toll of seven, the state of siege, and FPMR claims and denials.
